text:
Type: experience
Title: Forward Deployed Engineer
Organization: Brainstorm.uno

Accomplishments:
- Develop and maintain full-stack features for an AI-powered startup ideation and collaboration platform, spanning user interfaces, APIs, databases, and application security.
- Orchestrate parallel AI coding agents using Claude and ChatGPT to implement features, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate development across frontend and backend components.
- Integrate AI capabilities into application workflows, connecting model outputs with backend services and user-facing features.

Type: experience
Title: Web Developer
Organization: StaySharpSD.com

Accomplishments:
- Developed full stack web application for Barbershop management / appointments
- Created / maintain PostgreSQL table for Barbers, schedule, availability, skills which is connected to the User Interface via express framework to connect a REST API for user to book appointment
- automation of haircut appointments increased number of bookings by 18%

Type: experience
Title: Chief Technical Officer
Organization: World Computing Organization(SDSU chapter)

Accomplishments:
- Collaboration with exec board / industry professionals to design and host weekly meetings for all SDSU students to leverage AI to become more competitive in their career paths
- Designed and lead projects, workshops, and guest speaker lectures (Agentic AI workshops, computer vision demos, business strategy)
- Defined and delegated specific responsibilities for each executive based on identification of their strength and weaknesses

Type: project
Title: EasyChefAI

Accomplishments:
- Full stack android app that allows users to interact with a chatbot to create a personalized fitness plan based on their fitness goals, weight, height, BMI, age, and dietary preferences
- Leveraged Google’s Gemini’s API to create an AI “fitness coach” which strictly gives advice for fitness and health
- Utilized prompt engineering, chat summarization, and API key rotation to reduce token usage by 35maintain consistent efficiency for chats
- Implemented unit testing to optimize performance before deployment

Type: project
Title: Linux / Unix Server development

Accomplishments:
- Built and administered a multi-VM infrastructure environment across OpenBSD, FreeBSD, AlmaLinux, Ubuntu, Solaris, and IBM AIX. With the goal of integrating networking, storage, authentication, security, and application services across heterogeneous operating systems
- Engineered core network and identity infrastructure using BIND9 forward/reverse DNS, LDAP centralized authentication, OpenSSL PKI/TLS certificates, SSH key authentication, VPN connectivity, port forwarding, and ProxyJump routing between systems
- Deployed and managed containerized NGINX services using Docker and Docker Compose, integrating systemd service management, NFS shared storage, automounting, firewall configuration, and centralized system resources

Type: project
Title: Handles
Organization: personal
Status: in progress

Accomplishments:
- Used data processing to create a dataset of 10k+ images consisting of frames from short videos of variety of players, environments, basketballs to result in consistent tracking of the basketball across each frame via YOLO and Bytetrack combination framework.
- Implementation of mediapipe pose estimation techniques to track 33 keypoints across the players body to improve accuracy of basketball skill assessment for feedback from AI model.
- After initial training of the YOLOv26s.pt, I refined the model with optimized parameters to increase accuracy of tracking the basketball to account for frequent occlution throughout the video

Type: project
Title: Change Order Automation
Organization: AI CLUB
Status: in progress

Accomplishments:
- Developing a React Native and FastAPI app for contractors to document work changes with photos, route them to the office, and request client approval.
- Built backend endpoints for photo submission, office review, and approval decisions.
- Designing a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline that uses an AI model and AWS-hosted knowledge bases to compare proposed changes with project scope and provide context for office review.
